title: Cover the three workflow-lifecycle verbs that no test has ever driven
action: run_start_feature (verbs/state_group/policy.rs:554), run_workflows_list and run_workflows_close (verbs/state_group/workflows.rs:38 and :106) have ZERO test call sites — grep finds only their definitions and their router dispatch entries. Everything below them is unit-tested (ensure_workflow_record_for_feature idempotence, close_workflows_for_feature keep-only-named, seed_legacy_workflows gating, create_workflow refusals in workflow_store/tests.rs), so the untested layer is exactly the one that assembles those seams into a command: flag parsing, target resolution, the refusal wording, the emitted payload, and the exit code. Write that coverage. Drive the real verb surface — either the run_* entry points directly (the way state_group/tests.rs drives run_set_body) or the built binary through an integration test under crates/bee/tests/ (the cells_archive_sweep.rs pattern) — whichever actually reaches them; do not test a private helper and call it verb coverage. Cover, at minimum: a clean start-feature creates the feature's workflow record and leaves the record readable by workflows list; start-feature's guarded refusals fail closed with zero mutations (a non-terminal prior phase, an active reservation, a claimed cell, a nonterminal cell of the prior feature, a live workflow for the target feature); workflows list reports every record with its status and phase; workflows close closes the named feature's records and leaves others alone; and close's --all-but-active guard refuses or spares the active feature exactly as resolve_active_feature_for_workflows_close decides (its helper already has a unit test at state_group/tests.rs:1070 — the gap is the verb around it). Where a refusal is asserted, assert the message names the blocker and that nothing reached disk.

truths: Each of run_start_feature, run_workflows_list and run_workflows_close is reached by at least one test through its real entry point
A clean start-feature is proven to create the workflow record, and each guarded refusal is proven to fail closed with zero mutations
workflows close is proven to close the named feature's records and to leave every other record untouched
The --all-but-active path is exercised through the verb, not only through its helper
No production behavior changes in this cell — it is test-only; if a test exposes a real defect, report it in the outcome instead of quietly fixing it

artifacts.substantive: new tests driving the three verbs, or a note in the outcome saying they live in crates/bee/tests/ instead and why

key_links: the tests reach run_start_feature / run_workflows_list / run_workflows_close themselves
the seam-level unit tests below them stay untouched

decisions: A verb with zero test call sites is untested however well its seams are covered (finding logged 2026-08-05 during the stale-lane sweep)

trace.outcome: Added packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/workflow_verbs.rs: 16 integration tests driving run_start_feature, run_workflows_list and run_workflows_close through the built binary (no run_x_body split exists for this trio, so an in-process unit test would assert on nothing) — clean start-feature + listing, all five start-feature guarded refusals with zero-mutation proof, workflows list mixed status/phase, close by --feature/--id/--all-but-active each leaving other records untouched, and both close modes refusing rather than degrading to "all" when the active feature is unresolvable. state_group/tests.rs untouched (test-only, no production change; no defect found).
